_meta.reason: Guide 2.0a (2019) lists Bios, Bios/SD, ResetBios, ChangePassword as "only X11DP supports"; later X11 firmware not documented in any public guide found. Registry content is on-device only.
_meta.protocol_for_bios: json (X11DP only, unverified for other X11) ; xml via SUM
_meta.device_dump: GET /redfish/v1/Registries -> BiosAttributeRegistry -> Location[].Uri ; GET /redfish/v1/Systems/1/Bios ; GET /redfish/v1/Systems/1/Bios/SD (SUM alternative: sum -i <BMC> -u <USER> -p <PASS> -c GetCurrentBiosCfg --file bios.xml)
